name: September 7 - September 13 Round Up
summary: Weekly AI for UX round up of links on agentic interface patterns, design systems for AI-generated UI and AI models for product design.
description: A weekly round-up post on the AI for UX Substack by Patrick Neeman (13 September 2026). It links and summarises that week's writing on AI in product design: agentic UX patterns such as planning visibility, tool-use disclosure, memory surfacing and recovery routing; five eras of UX design; enforcing AI-generated UI with a design system; head-to-head model comparisons for design work; AI-ready Figma handoff; and AI text watermarking.
contains: weekly round up of AI for UX links, 7-13 September 2026
topics: agentic UX patterns, design systems that enforce AI-generated UI, model comparisons for product design
